column2: He may not look it, but Koji-kun's a great cook!
I can't wait!
For sure! Don't forget!
I won't forget, Koji-kun...
Senki and Goki say it's time to go back...
It seems even the Demon King could not control the Kigoku World. Perhaps the Kigoku World is an inner world someone created.
Whatever kind of world it is, someday I'll get to the bottom of its mystery!
I will always protect Doji.
I will always keep fighting...
With you two around, Jiro-kun will be fine!
No!
When we go back to our world, you'll have to go back to the Kigoku World, won't you! I won't have it! I won't leave Jiro-kun's side!
It's all right. I'll never leave you...
That's right! Even if your worlds are apart, your hearts are together!
Yes! Thank you, {p}-kun!
Be happy, you two!
So long, {p}!
{p}! It was a blast. So long!
Enma-kun... What's wrong?
He doesn't want you to see his tears, my boy.
Oh, it's true! He's cryin'!
Shaddap!
Hell Villa can go anywhere in the human world. I'll come hang out at your school sometime!
We'll be waiting in the gym storeroom!
Yeah! I'll definitely come!
For sure! It's a promise!
We sure took turns saving each other, didn't we!
It was quite the thrill!
What're you talkin' about, you were always hidin' behind me!
Boss, don't bring that up.
Anyway, I learned a lot from {p}-kun! As a descendant of the Yagyu ninja, I've got to follow his example!
Jubei, you're so serious!
When we get back to our world, I wonder if homework'll be waiting again?
Never mind that, let's think up ways to pick on Higegodzilla! Ihhihhihhi...!
Those guys didn't change one bit. But somehow, that makes me happy!
Mondo-san, Ryoma-san, thanks for everything!
I don't really wanna go back...
How come, Mondo!?
With the Demon King dead, this world's got no ruler, right? So I could...
Oh, come ooon, you'd be bored without anybody to take it from!
Yeah, that's true! Good thinkin'!
Of course! I'm your partner!
You two make a great team!
That's right! We'll never part, not even in death, hmmm~!
Hey, hey...!
...Not even in death, eh...\n\nAn even harsher fate may be awaiting you two back in your world...
Jack-san, you should smile once in a while...
Did I make Jack-san mad...?
I'm sorry it turned out like this with {s}.
Akira-kun...
If something like this ever happens again... next time I'd like to go with you. A different fate might be waiting...
...Yeah.\n\nBut I've had enough of this kind of thing!
Fair enough!
If it ever happens again, huh... No way!
{p}-kun... It's finally just us...
Honey...
Honey-chan...
I can't exactly tell you to cheer up...
It's okay, Seiji-kun.\n\nHoney will never forget Natsu-chan! So... so you too, {p}... okay?
It'll be okay. I'm sure Natsu-chan is safe!
You're right, {p}-kun!\n\nWhen I get back to my world, I'm sure Natsu-chan will be just fine!
That's right! And {s}'s waiting for you too!
That's right, Seiji-san!
{p}-kun!
Goodbye, Honey!
Bye-bye! {p}-kun! Goodbye!
This is...
Everything's perfectly fine... Then that really was...!
In that world... Natsu-chan...
burned in the fire to protect Honey...
Honey!
Eek! N-Natsu-chan!?
What's with that look, like you're seeing a ghost!? Honey was so late getting back, I got worried and came to get you!
I'm sorryyy! Natsu-chan, I love you!
Hey, what's gotten into you, Honey!?
Sorry. Just let me stay like this for a while!
No!
Histler, the dorm head, is coming on her rounds. If you dawdle, she'll catch us!! Come on, this way, this way...!
Hurry, hurry!
Thanks, Natsu-chan...
Hey, Honey! Where are you touching!
Tee-hee! Natsu-chan, your butt is so cute!
I'm sorry, {s}...\n\nI couldn't save you...
Was our own world really such an awful place...
It's better than this world. Because... you're not here!
This place... I recognize it, but... is this really our own world...?
Is this really our own world...?
All kinds of things happened in the world the Demon King controlled at will... But which of the things that happened there were real, only the Demon King knows...\n\nBut...
In my arms... {s}'s body... isn't here! That means...!!\n\nThe world has started to set itself right!
The world has started to set itself right!
The Demon King is dead! The patchwork world is gone! The world... has started to set itself right...!\n\nEverything... everything is going back to how it was! Everything's back to how it was!
Everything... everything is going back to how it was! Everything's back to how it was!
*Pant*... *pant*...
Everything's back to how it was!
*Pant*... *pant*...
My phone... got an e-mail...
An e-mail...
When the black moon shines, let us meet...
Let's head out too!
